scripts.build:auth: npm run generate:auth && nest build ms-auth && cp -r apps/ms-auth/src/generated dist/apps/ms-auth/src/
scripts.build:orders: npm run generate:orders && nest build ms-orders && cp -r apps/ms-orders/src/generated dist/apps/ms-orders/src/
scripts.build:payment: npm run generate:payment && nest build ms-payment && cp -r apps/ms-payment/src/generated dist/apps/ms-payment/src/
scripts.build:products: npm run generate:products && nest build ms-products && cp -r apps/ms-products/src/generated dist/apps/ms-products/src/
scripts.build:stock: npm run generate:stock && nest build ms-stock && cp -r apps/ms-stock/src/generated dist/apps/ms-stock/src/
